# Reference observations

These JSON fixtures record computed CSS values and interaction states observed in the published [LoL Math Storybook](https://ui.lolmath.net/). They contain measurements, not copied component source, fonts or artwork. The deployed revision was not established; retain that limitation when comparing results.

The reference scripts read these portable fixtures and write new observations to ignored `.artifacts/`. Update a fixture only after reviewing actual reference states. Licensed font substitutions are documented in [third-party notices](../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
